items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf; movement found on follow-up ultrasound. Tanner McKee to start. Indefinite timeline possible as treatment determined.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound Wednesday night showed movement in small clot originally found pre-London game; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense/ implied total down; Saquon/Smith usage may shift if also limited; Panthers DST upgrade.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Eagles pass-catchers volume if McKee airs it out, or run-heavy if conservative; reverse if Hurts returns soon.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and are OUT vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Full backfield to Woody Marks (98% snaps last week when Monty left); low-end RB2 despite tough matchup.
items.opportunity: Marks handles all RB touches/snaps; reverse stale Monty handcuff beneficiaries.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return vs SEA due to shoulder injury, then returned to the game.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return.
items.implication: No lasting absence this week; monitor for lingering effects ROS/next.
items.opportunity: Full role restored mid-game; reverse any mid-game beneficiary assumptions.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle WR28 on usage/matchup (SEA tough, low yards outside one game).

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore DNP second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of OUT/Q; monitor Friday report for Week 6 status vs LV.
items.opportunity: Potential target share boost to other Bills WRs if limited/out.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Questionable/OUT risk vs LAR; depth chart shift possible.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for other ARI RBs if out.

items.text: Eagles: Saquon Barkley no practice again (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.why: Barkley consecutive DNP hamstring; Smith upgrade from prior.
items.implication: Barkley GTD/OUT risk with Hurts already out; Smith more likely active.
items.opportunity: If Barkley out, Gainwell or others elevate; Smith role stable/up.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP again Thursday due to hamstring.
items.implication: Q/OUT risk; Worthy/others elevated targets if limited.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially DNP again Thursday (ankle).
items.implication: Status uncertain; backup if out impacts Ravens offense.
items.opportunity: Flowers/Henry/Andrews usage may change with backup QB.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day; on track to start vs Falcons.
items.implication: Expected to start; Bears offense upgrade, higher total.

items.text: Berry LOVES Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ), Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH). Soft matchups + volume/roles.
items.why: WSH defense buffet for pass-catchers; elite recent usage (Kyren); goal-line (Javonte); volume post-Henderson (Rhamondre); high-scoring spots.
items.opportunity: Confirmed high snaps/routes/targets/carries/RZ in favorable spots.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18 vs CHI), Woody Marks (RB22 vs JAX), JK Dobbins (RB27 vs SEA), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA), Justin Herbert (QB25 @KC). Ugly matchups, shaky QB/usage, tough run Ds, low totals.
items.why: SEA pass D elite; low recent production/usage; tough run defenses; lowest team totals.
items.opportunity: Poor projected snaps/routes vs tough spots; Marks volume good but matchup overrides for Berry.
items.conflict: Marks volume elite (98% when Monty out) but Berry fades matchup.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week out (high ankle); Rhamondre Stevenson saw 85% snaps/23 touches in prior inactive game, avg 16.3 PPG on >15 touches since 2024. Giddy up for volume.
items.why: Pats announced multi-week; prior full workload data.
items.implication: Stevenson clear RB1/ every-down; strong start vs NYJ.

items.text: 49ers opened practice window for WR Christian Kirk (IR, calf all season).
items.implication: Potential activation soon; depth chart impact for SF WRs.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; if SB contender with RB need, at least call. Worth risk moving year early vs late.
items.why: Age curve + Eagles precedent; current hamstring DNP context.
items.implication: Monitor trade rumors; potential landing spot boost or PHI exit risk for ROS value.
items.opportunity: If traded to contender, usage may stay high; PHI backups elevate short-term.
